status: exploratory protocol frozen before executing the CPR0 cluster proxy fit
naming_warning: Do not call this Covariant Refracted Gravity or CRG; that name and acronym belong to Sanna, Matsakos, and Diaferio.

equations: nabla^2 Phi = div[(1+B h(g_N)) grad Phi_N]
div[epsilon_RG(rho_b) grad Phi] = 4 pi G rho_b

exact_endpoint_requirements: C=1 recovers the fixed-B Sigma QUMOND equation
rho_b >> rho_c and g_N >> g_dagger recovers Newtonian gravity
all response coefficients remain finite and positive
rejected_primary_combination: Multiplying Sigma enhancement by 1/epsilon_RG double counts two missing-gravity responses and is retained only as a diagnostic control.

coherence_rule.leakage_rule: C may use measured positions and velocities but never the target acceleration, inferred missing mass, fitted halo, or model-predicted velocity.
coherence_rule.current_cluster_screen: C=0 endpoint only; this does not test the coherence hypothesis or the intermediate interpolation.

cluster_proxy_screen.lensing_mapping: zero-slip effective-acceleration proxy only; CPR0 does not yet derive the two metric potentials or photon propagation
cluster_proxy_screen.density_proxy: mean enclosed baryonic density 3 g_bar/(4 pi G r), not the local density required by exact RG
cluster_proxy_screen.fit_objective: equal-cluster mean of unweighted squared log10 acceleration residuals
models: published galaxy RG parameters without refit
cross-validated universal RG parameters using the declared density proxy

claim_boundary: A pass would justify acquiring local baryon-density and measured-coherence profiles; it would not validate CPR0.
A failure of the mean-density proxy does not by itself falsify exact Refracted Gravity.
CPR0 has no closed covariant action, derived gravitational slip, photon equation, PPN solution, or cosmology.
The exact CPR0 interpolation was not found in a targeted literature search, but no originality claim is made without a comprehensive ADS/INSPIRE and citation audit.
